summary.tldr: Requires the Minister of Health to develop a national framework on sickle cell disease and report it to Parliament.
what_it_does: Requires the Minister of Health to develop a national framework on sickle cell disease.
Calls for measures on health worker training, education, diagnostic and treatment tools, and evidence-based national standards for diagnosis and treatment.
Creates a national research network, with better data collection and a national registry on sickle cell disease.
Includes measures for universal newborn screening, public awareness, and wider blood donation to support safe transfusions.
Requires analysis of a tax credit, disability benefit eligibility, and the inclusion of needed treatments in public drug insurance plans.
Requires the minister to consult provincial and territorial governments, health and research groups, and other relevant people before finalising the framework.
summary.background: Sickle cell disease is also called sickle cell anemia or drepanocytosis.
